tools.name: kp_index_now
tools.description: What is the Kp index right now? Returns the current planetary Kp (0-9), its storm level (G1-G5 if any) and the 3-hourly values for the last 24 hours (or up to 7 days), from NOAA SWPC. Useful for aurora chasers, radio amateurs and anyone asking whether a geomagnetic storm is under way. It reports obs

tools.name: kp_forecast_3day
tools.description: Will there be a geomagnetic storm in the next few days? Returns the NOAA SWPC predicted Kp for each 3-hour block over the next 3 days, the daily maximum, the peak block and any G-scale storm expected. For planning aurora trips and checking storm watches. Forecasts are uncertain by hours and 1-2 Kp;

tools.name: aurora_chance_at_location
tools.description: Can I see the northern (or southern) lights from here right now? Returns the probability of aurora overhead at a latitude and longitude from the NOAA SWPC OVATION model, a 30-90 minute forecast, plus the best chance within 5 degrees poleward (aurora there can show on the horizon). Works worldwide. I

tools.name: space_weather_scales
tools.description: How bad is space weather right now? Returns the current NOAA space weather scales for radio blackouts (R), solar radiation storms (S) and geomagnetic storms (G), the maximum of the past 24 hours, and NOAA SWPC probabilities for the next 3 days. Useful for HF radio users, pilots, drone and GPS users,

tools.name: space_weather_alerts
tools.description: Is there a solar storm warning? Returns the latest official NOAA SWPC alerts, watches and warnings (geomagnetic storm watches, K-index warnings, flare and proton alerts) with type, headline, issue time and the verbatim message text. Useful for newsrooms and enthusiasts who need the official wording.

tools.name: solar_flares_recent
tools.description: Was there a big solar flare today? Lists X-ray flares detected by the GOES satellites in the last 1-7 days, newest first, with class (A, B, C, M, X), begin, peak and end times, peak flux and the NOAA radio blackout level implied, plus the largest flare in the period. From NOAA SWPC. It covers flares

tools.name: solar_wind_speed
tools.description: How fast is the solar wind right now? Returns the latest solar wind speed in km/s measured upstream of Earth, from NOAA SWPC, with a plain-language level (slow, moderate, fast, very fast). tools.description: What is the solar flux index today?
